deltas_to_close.divergence: Inspector section headers render sentence-case; prototype .sect-hd (L82-83) is text-transform:uppercase. Native already uppercases its INSPECTOR panel header.
deltas_to_close.fix: Uppercase the inspector section headers to match the prototype.

deltas_to_close.divergence: Inspector key/value rows are inline key: value that wrap mid-word; long values (64-char revision hash, pool path) break poorly across lines. Prototype .kv (L86) is an aligned 2-col grid grid-template-columns:100px 1fr.
deltas_to_close.fix: Adopt the prototype 2-col grid. For values longer than the prototype's placeholders, the value column wraps WITHIN its own column — no overflow into the label column, no truncation that hides data. Long-value wrap is an ordinary implementation choice made inside the execution grant; the prototype never demonstrated it.
